short_description: Procedural geomorphology derived from accepted G7 semantic fields and G3/G5/G6 surface, feature and hydrology truth.
purpose: Add deterministic valley, river-channel, bank, floodplain and erosion/deposition shaping without taking ownership of persistent Matter mutations, world identity, authority, persistence or material ontology.
expected_outcome: A replaceable, provenance-friendly geomorphology layer that produces stable surface deformation independent from SurfaceCellKey, LOD, camera and representation and can later feed geology/volume/detail stages.
progress_note: G8.0 Geomorphology Contracts is ACCEPTED after exact-Windows full acceptance on head 7a34c5d58b5a766fd8f4da46073dfcea29673fe9 with G7 parent PASS, geomorphology contracts/ownership PASS, world/core regression through NX4 PASS, RL3 representation-aware streaming 175 assertions, RL3 process streaming 37 assertions, main_scene_cli_all 6 PASS / 0 FAIL, STOPPED lifecycle and CLEAN working tree. G8.1 is now implemented as a replaceable valley-only baseline over accepted geo/surface-height-m + geo/valley-influence semantics. Formula: valley_delta_m = -valley_max_depth_m * pow(valley_influence, valley_exponent). Zero influence gives zero incision; unit influence reaches the profile cap; the result is monotonic, profile-bounded and leaves river/bank/floodplain/erosion-deposition components at zero. No SurfaceCellKey, LOD, Matter, authority, persistence, material or network ownership is introduced. Focused Windows validation is pending; the full acceptance runner is already present so both gates can run on one unchanged checkout.
